authority.rule: Resolve the live PR head before testing or mutation. Documentation commits may move HEAD beyond the runtime/scientific baseline. Never force-reset to a remembered SHA.

android.test_rule: An APK is current only after its SHA-256, package/version and signer identity are tied to the intended source state. Do not infer currency from filename.

permanent_scientific_laws: Seal the evidence, not the thinking.
Representation may become richer than the source; knowledge claims may not exceed evidence.
One Free World. Many sealed observations. One evidence law.
Direct-CFA and RAW_SENSOR evidence are immutable and sealed.
One physical frame remains one physical frame; derived views do not create captures.
Scientific Master is scene-linear and separate from presentation/export/appearance.
UNKNOWN is valid and must not silently become zero, certainty or estimate.
Precision, resolution, reconstruction, registration and performance do not create authority.
Camera/vendor identity may route parsing but may not choose scientific truth.
SOURCE/SENSOR SPACE, WORLD/SCENE SPACE and VIEW/OUTPUT SPACE remain distinct.
No performance, diagnostic, reconstruction or appearance path may mutate sealed evidence or measured anchors or write back scientific truth without explicit admitted authority.
